description: A serene private head beneath its own small skylight that tracks the weather: pale plaster, warm oak, a walk-in shower open to the falling light. A soft-edged basin, a concealed toilet, a fogged pane that watches the storms roll in from somewhere safe and dry. The heating is underfoot and the silence is total. The door seals with a soft magnetic sigh.
name: Residence 30-C — Ensuite
